summary.en: Build personas, journey maps and usability test plans

description.zh: 产出用户画像、旅程图、可用性测试计划和调研结论。适合在弄清用户是谁、他们在哪一步卡住，或准备安排一轮测试时使用。
description.en: Produces personas, journey maps, usability test plans and research synthesis. Use it to clarify who your users are, where they get stuck, or how to structure a usability study.
